notes.title: Patch Note 0827
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

While the store page was down, our dev team added a new map, and also made a bunch other improvements.

Updates:
- new map added: Athens
- removed map: Damascus
- match server optimization
- warehouse event adjustment: doors are open now, and you don’t have to break the door anymore
- fixed the bug where it was impossible to pick up an item if it fell in an opened box
- fixed the bug of best plunderer not updating properly to other players when the best plunderer quit the match in the middle of a play
- fixed the bug of best plunderer not updating to players that came in the middle of a game
- time machine will spawn 6 minutes before the end of game, waits in the sky for 1 minute, and comes down to the ground when 5 minutes are left
- adjusted amount of gold drops from treasure boxes
- changed the direction when respawning
- full shield will be applied when respawning
- fixed the bug where the transport UI disappears when the time machine is fully spawned.
- fixed the bug of respawned players getting killed with assassination skill during the 10 second invincible time

Please leave comments and let us know what you think of the changes.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update on Store Issue
notes.content:
Hello,

We apologize for the long wait.

There was an issue with one of our maps and our steam store page had to be shut down to resolve the issue. It took us longer than expected, but while working on resolving the issue we have also made some improvements to our game.
We will post the patch note separately.

Currently, the issue has been resolved and we have completely removed the map. We have added a new map “Athens”, so please make sure to check out our new map.

Again, we apologize for the inconvenience caused, and thank you for your support.

Thank you!

notes.title: Patch note 0730 (Applied)
notes.content:
Hello,

We're pleased to announce our very first patch.
We've listened to you voice, and made some adjustments!

There will be a brief server shut down. (less than 10 minutes)
Please refer to below for the schedule:

01:00 EDT
20:00 PDT

Patch detail:
- adjusted item price
- adjusted respawn time
- adjusted respawn cost
- adjusted map function
- adjusted minimum players required for match to start
- weapons will be dropped when killed
- changed consumable box ratio
- adjusted assassination angle


Thank you for your support!
